    """Shift-and matcher for a priority-ordered set of interval patterns."""
    def __init__(self, patterns):
        self.start_mask = 0
        self.end_mask = 0

                coordinate_bit = 1 << (base+offset)
                self._events[lo][coordinate_bit] = self._events[lo].get(coordinate_bit, 0) ^ coordinate_bit
                if hi+1 <= 3029:
                    self._events[hi+1][coordinate_bit] = self._events[hi+1].get(coordinate_bit, 0) ^ coordinate_bit
            bit += length
        self._masks = [0]*3029
        active = 0
        for value in range(3029):
            for flag, toggle in self._events[value].items():
                active ^= toggle
            self._masks[value] = 0 if value == 1514 else active
        self._clear_starts = ~self.start_mask

    def step(self, state, value):
